scope: Clarify retry classification and bounded scheduling; all other parent fields unchanged.

retry_proposal.counter_scope: Same exact prepared execution launch across the entire continuation, including owner/controller restarts; never reset by a new process, request ID, owner or calendar interval.
retry_proposal.eligible_failure: Authenticated infrastructure failure before the scientific payload was ever started.
retry_proposal.required_evidence: Authenticated owner/controller launch receipts must positively establish that the payload never crossed the launch/start boundary, bound to the exact request, execution, instrument, owner and job/process identities and complete attempt history. The precise producer boundary and receipt verification must be source-reviewed and bound in the prospective protocol.
insufficient_evidence: a Pod or Job status alone
must_match: exact prepared execution identity and seed
existing campaign ledger and remaining allowance
retry_proposal.unknown_classification: Stop and preserve evidence; no automatic launch or retry. Any replacement scientific execution requires a separate prospective decision and valid remaining authorization.
retry_proposal.admission_before_retry: Retry is only eligible, not automatically admitted: authenticate no-start evidence, reconcile absence of live owner/payload, charge prior work and verify remaining ledger/deadline, retain all original records, and satisfy the frozen protocol and execution bindings.

accounting.remaining_allowance_source: Authenticated cumulative owner/campaign ledger; no estimate from elapsed wall clock and no restart reset.
accounting.stop: Stop at the earliest applicable cumulative or absolute limit. Collection and recovery also remain within the same limits. Unknown accounting blocks admission.

scheduling.reserve_status: Unapproved scheduling proposal; may only tighten limits, never extend them; not a measured duration or completion guarantee.
scheduling.incomplete_outcome: Retain all attempted and missing slots with capped/incomplete/unknown status and null unqualified ratios. The full 1260-target scope and separate 18-slot gate remain unchanged even if the campaign cannot finish them.

scientific_gate.status: Unapproved pending source and counter-equivalence review plus an explicit prospective scientific decision.
scientific_gate.scope: Separate p186379 target0 18-slot gate, not cohort enrollment; complete gate and independent review remain prerequisites to remainder.

text_replacements_proposed.instruction: Replace ambiguous max_attempts wording with retry_proposal above when constructing the reviewed canonical protocol.

text_replacements_proposed.text: Retain interruption, checkpoint and restore records. Any post-spawn/preemption/unknown-start failure stops automatic scientific retry; resumed clocks remain invalid. Only authenticated never-started-payload infrastructure failures may be eligible for at most one retry, two total attempts including initial, under unchanged inputs/instrument and remaining campaign limits.
